title: Show HN: Tamper-evident audit logs for LangChain/Crew AI agents
summary: I have been running into the same problems recently instrumenting my LangChain and CrewAI agent pipelines. If something goes wrong with a tool call, there was no way to way to prove what the agent did, in what order, and whether the logs have been modified. Observability platforms like LangSmith and Langfuse are great at optimizing for agent behavior, tokens and costs but they do not produce legally defensible and auditable artifacts.
